riley: quick check-inran speculative rollforward patch on llama4t-70b-q4f (mixed q4f kernels). microbench shows ~2.3x token throughput and p50 down ~1.9x. but codegen BLEU@5 dropped ~3.4 pts on code-holdout-v2 and ROUGE-L down ~1.2 on long-summaries.
jess: which speculative strategy? rollforward vs two-stage?
riley: rollforward predictor (greedy with lookahead=4) + verifier greedy. early_abort=0.05, kv_prefetch=true. fallback=full-decode.
arun: can you paste the run command?
riley: sure:
```
./eval_harness \
  --model=llama4t-70b-q4f \
  --spec_mode=rollforward \
  --lookahead=4 \
  --early_abort=0.05 \
  --kv_prefetch=true \
  --tasks=codegen,summarization \
  --holdouts=code-holdout-v2,summ-long-v1 \
  --batch=4
```
jess: code BLEU drop is concerning. any sign verifier failing often (i.e., low accept_rate)?
riley: accept_rate ~65% on code tasks, ~74% on summarization. interestingly most regressions in code are around context-sensitive indent/closing-brace issues.
arun: that smells like short fast-path completions missing trailing tokens. Did you measure avg_fastpath_len vs final_added_tokens?
riley: yes: avg_fastpath_len=22 tokens, avg_final_added=48 tokens. delta bigger for code.
jess: did you try increasing lookahead or lowering early_abort?
riley: small run with lookahead=8 increased accept_rate to 78% and BLEU improved to -1.1 vs baseline, but throughput dropped to ~1.8x. tradeoff but promising.
arun: maybe route by task: codegen -> conservative spec (lookahead>=8 or disable for ctx_len>1024), summarization -> aggressive.
riley: added routing prototype `spec_route(task==codegen -> lookahead=8)` and queued a sweep.
ci-bot: job 7365433001 finished - logs: https://ci/internal/arty/7365433001 - artifacts: /artifacts/7365433001/metrics.json
jess: also run paired-bootstrap on code BLEU with n=2000 to check significance. if p<0.01 we consider blocking.
arun: add telemetry: accept_rate_by_task, avg_fastpath_len_by_task, verifier_extra_tokens_by_task, and per-case diffs for top-100 regressions.
riley: will push branch `exp/rollforward-llama4t-q4f-736543` and tag `spec-roll-2026-03-21`. queued paired-bootstrap.
jess: ack. i'll triage top code regressions tomorrow (focus on brace/indent and inference of types).
riley: thanks all will post consolidated numbers and sample diffs when paired-bootstrap finishes. :mag:
